system.description:
The other side of Infernal Aura's coin, Unholy Aura allows a Baali to remain undaunted by most expressions of True Faith. The stench of spiritual corruption surrounding the Baali is literally so strong that holy things cannot abide it: minor relics crumble to dust in the Baali's hand, holy men and women flee her gaze (or suffer horrible consequences), and even consecrated places can be turned to evil by the Baali's mere presence.

System: Any being with True Faith who faces a Baali with Unholy Aura must make a Willpower roll (difficulty 8) or flee the scene in terror. A botch on the roll indicates that the Baali's infernal power has literally reached out to taint the victim, causing some sort of injury (stigmata are popular) or even stripping True Faith away.
system.source: Clanbook: Baali, Chapter Three: Descent into Darkness
